seo.description: Rifat Sarwar: backend engineer who also does machine learning. Microservices on AWS, LLMs squeezed onto small hardware, a Mars rover ranked 6th globally, and drones built from scratch.

footer.tagline: Backend Engineer · Machine Learning. Built in Bangladesh with Next.js, curiosity and occasional panic.
footer.disclaimer: The AI twin is an AI, not actually Rifat, and it can be wrong. Chat messages go to Google's Gemini API to generate replies. This site doesn't store them, but Google may use them to improve its products, so don't share anything private.
